requirements.text: This role is a New York City based HYBRID position. Candidates must be located in NYC, and willing to come into the office on a hybrid basis, three times a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday).*
4+ years of experience shipping production-quality features in a data engineering or backend software engineering role
Experience developing data pipelines or microservices in Scala, Java, Go, or Python
Experience working with data processing frameworks such as Apache Beam, Scio, Apache Spark, Apache Flink is preferred
Familiarity with SQL and experience working with a data warehouse (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar)
Comfortable working in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
Experience with streaming or messaging systems such as Apache Kafka or Google Pub/Sub is a plus
You care about code quality and advocate for simple, maintainable solutions
You're curious and driven by problem solving, always looking to learn new technologies and approaches, including how AI tools can change the way we build data systems
You're a collaborative team player who communicates openly and enjoys working across disciplines to get things done
